candidate.user_submission: Pikin dey 18 months old. Im get fever for 2 days. Im body hot reach 38.0°C. Im malaria risk dey high. Malaria test dey and e show positive. Dem never see any identified bacterial cause for dis fever. Dem no see any obvious cause wey fit dey make am get fever. Pikin never get convulsion and e no dey convulse now. Pikin no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. Pikin fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. E never get measles for last 3 months and e no dey cough wey join with measles. Im body no show any generalized rash. Im eye no red and im no get runny nose. Im neck no stiff. Im no get cough or any wahala to breathe. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. Im get fever.
